name: FlyingChairs Optical Flow Benchmark
description: FlyingChairs is a synthetic optical flow dataset created to train end-to-end convolutional neural networks for optical flow estimation. Consisting of 22,872 image pairs generated by overlaying rendered 3D chair models moving along 2D affine motions onto Flickr background photographs, with dense ground-truth optical flow fields.
